title: Generating Formal Purchase Orders (PO) & PDF Export

intro.title: Purchase Orders & PDF Export
intro.subtitle: Formal procurement workflows, distributor item orders, multi-state PO approval, and branded PDF generation

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 5, Part 4: Generating Formal Purchase Orders and PDF Export. Structured purchase orders eliminate procurement discrepancies and streamline distributor communication.
Go to Purchases, then Orders, and click New Purchase Order. Select your distributor and set the expected delivery date.
Add required medicines to the order table. Specify order quantities and anticipated purchase rates per pack.
Add order notes for supplier dispatch instructions, then click Save Purchase Order. Review the generated PO with unique order numbering.
Approve the order and click Print or Export PDF to generate an inspector-ready purchase order document ready for WhatsApp or email dispatch. In Part 5, we receive the inward GRN against this PO!

outro.takeaway: Purchase Orders & PDF: Create formal distributor procurement orders, approve lines, and export professional PDF vouchers for rapid vendor fulfillment.
